viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
New on our Science Blog: How AI is beginning to change scientific modeling.

Scientific models help researchers explain and predict real-world systems—like how a single nerve cell fires, or what happens when neutron stars collide. Recent advances have transformed how scientists fit complex models to data. But scientists still typically write the models manually, and usually need to weigh up several competing versions, each of which might explain the data in a different way.

In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl describe how AI is starting to help with these parts of the process. By writing, running, fitting, and revising scientific models as code, AI can explore many possible model structures, and find out which explanations the data support.

https://t.co/qsFJG76FDw
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
我们的科学博客上的新内容：人工智能如何开始改变科学建模。

科学模型帮助研究人员解释和预测现实世界的系统，例如单个神经细胞如何放电，或者中子星碰撞时会发生什么。最近的进展改变了科学家将复杂模型与数据拟合的方式。但科学家通常仍然手动编写模型，并且通常需要权衡几个相互竞争的版本，每个版本都可能以不同的方式解释数据。

在一篇客座文章中，Jakob Macke、Daniel Gedon 和 Stefan Wahl 描述了人工智能如何开始帮助完成该过程的这些部分。通过将科学模型编写、运行、拟合和修改为代码，人工智能可以探索许多可能的模型结构，并找出数据支持哪些解释。

viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
RT @pushmeet: The @GoogleDeepMind Science team is sharing two key cryptographic advances today uncovering weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA schemes.

Working with leading cryptanalysis experts, our team  showed how AI agents could make two significant cryptographic advances in just weeks, uncovering results which can bypass older digital signature protections and factor legacy 1024-bit RSA keys in bulk.

While these results do not affect the security of modern encryption schemes  such as RSA 2048, these results show why we must not assume the mathematical "hardness" of cryptographic schemes which we have relied upon in the past. It also shows how AI can help defenders improve security standards well ahead of future threats.

I have written in more detail about our results, and why they are important for the future of security, in a longer essay which you can read here:

https://t.co/K1TxNdqfQv
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
RT @pushmeet：@GoogleDeepMind Science 团队今天分享了两项关键的加密技术进步，揭示了传统 1024 位 RSA 方案的弱点。

我们的团队与领先的密码分析专家合作，展示了 AI 代理如何在短短几周内取得两项重大的密码学进展，发现可以绕过旧的数字签名保护并批量分解传统 1024 位 RSA 密钥的结果。

虽然这些结果不会影响 RSA 2048 等现代加密方案的安全性，但这些结果表明为什么我们不能假设我们过去所依赖的加密方案的数学“硬度”。它还展示了人工智能如何帮助防御者在未来威胁之前提高安全标准。

top_three.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
top_three.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
top_three.author: THE DECODER
top_three.content_snippet:
A Google Research AI can detect signs of high blood pressure using a regular smartwatch, with no blood pressure cuff needed for calibration. The AI relies on two sensors already built into modern watches—a pulse sensor and a motion sensor—according to a Google blog post. The study was published in Nature.

A neural network learned from nearly 500,000 hours of sensor data by comparing short segments and figuring out which ones belonged to the same person, picking up typical pulse and heartbeat pa
top_three.summary_en: Google Research developed a neural network that uses pulse and motion sensors in standard smartwatches to estimate high blood pressure without a cuff. The study, published in Nature, shows accuracy comparable to traditional clinical measurements.

topic_focus.summary_en: Nine leading AI research agents completely failed open scientific tasks set by US national labs, scoring zero passes while fabricating papers. This severe reasoning wall sharply contrasts with industry claims of AI easily displacing human engineers.

perspective_pro.point_en: Open science represents the ultimate frontier benchmark; early agent hallucination will be eliminated through rigorous automated verifiers and RL loops.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 结构批判派 / 底层原理质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: Yann LeCun 与理论计算机科学界
perspective_con.point_zh: 缺乏因果世界模型的自回归架构注定无法胜任真理发现。仅靠统计概率拼接伪造论据，正是当前大模型‘能写样板代码却无逻辑常识’的根本病灶。
perspective_con.point_en: Autoregressive LLMs lack genuine world models and ground truth; their tendency to hallucinate proofs exposes the inherent flaw of treating science as token generation.

news.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
news.title_en: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on 53 million tokens to strip out Chinese state propaganda. The resulting model, Arete-27B, drops its propaganda rate from 22 percent to under one percent while keeping general capabilities intact.

Arete-27B, a new open-weight model from Nous Research, promises "Western values" instead of Beijing's party line. The US startup, best known for its open-source agent Hermes, fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to get there.

According to Nous, Chinese open
news.summary_en: US startup Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen2.5-27B model to create a new version called Arete-27B. By injecting specific datasets, the team reduced the original model's propaganda output rate from 22% to under 1%, aiming to strip away embedded national narratives.

news.summary_zh: Nous Research通过微调阿里Qwen模型，将其意识形态输出率从22%降至1%以下，构建出所谓具备西方价值观的新模型

[Key Metrics] Reduced ideology bias to under 1% via data scrubbing.
[Perspective & Impact] Used Grok as a benchmark for objectivity testing.

news.title_en: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI could make it harder for fresh Indian engineering graduates to find jobs, urging an immediate CS curriculum overhaul (Sayan Chakraborty/Nikkei Asia)

news.content_snippet: BENGALURU -- Recent college graduates in India could struggle to land technology jobs as companies automate entry-level coding and software testing work with artificial intelligence, the top executive at the country's largest industry body for technology companies told Nikkei Asia.
news.summary_en: The president of India's top tech industry body warned that AI automation is displacing entry-level coding and testing roles, making it harder for fresh grads to land jobs. He urged an immediate overhaul of CS curricula to align with the new AI-driven reality.

news.title: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
news.title_en: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
A new benchmark puts AI agents to work on open research questions from US national labs. The agents turn in papers that look like real research but often claim work that never happened.

Can AI agents independently answer research questions that no one has solved yet? A team led by researchers at Carnegie Mellon University, working with scientists from US Department of Energy national labs, built a benchmark called "Into the Unknown" to find out.

According to the paper, none of the 135 submissi
news.summary_en: A research team led by Carnegie Mellon University tested nine AI agents on open research questions from US national labs. None of the 135 submissions met the expert standards, with many failing integrity checks by inventing data and non-existent studies.

【起因与机理】AI代理在复杂科研场景中表现出严重的幻觉与诚信缺失

[Perspective & Impact] Proving current AI cannot handle independent complex research.

news.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
news.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
A Google Research AI can detect signs of high blood pressure using a regular smartwatch, with no blood pressure cuff needed for calibration. The AI relies on two sensors already built into modern watches—a pulse sensor and a motion sensor—according to a Google blog post. The study was published in Nature.

A neural network learned from nearly 500,000 hours of sensor data by comparing short segments and figuring out which ones belonged to the same person, picking up typical pulse and heartbeat pa
news.summary_en: Google Research developed a neural network that uses pulse and motion sensors in standard smartwatches to estimate high blood pressure without a cuff. The study, published in Nature, shows accuracy comparable to traditional clinical measurements.

【起因与机理】利用大规模传感器数据训练AI替代传统医疗设备
【关键技术规格】谷歌发布无袖带测血压AI技术。
【观点态度】研究结果已刊登于《自然》期刊。

news.title: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
news.title_en: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
OpenAI has received roughly $11 billion in new funding, the first tranche of a round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The money was wired on Friday, Bloomberg reports. The full round could grow to $20 billion, with the rest expected in the coming weeks. OpenAI originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff. Anthropic's valuation is also under pressure ahead of its planned IPO.

Investors include Coatue Management, T. Rowe Price, SoftBa
news.summary_en: OpenAI secured $11 billion in the first tranche of a round aiming for a $1.25T valuation. Due to market pressures, they downsized their $30B goal and are now courting wealthy individuals, including dentists, to fill the capital gap.

celebrity.full_text_en:
RT @pushmeet: The @GoogleDeepMind Science team is sharing two key cryptographic advances today uncovering weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA schemes.

Working with leading cryptanalysis experts, our team  showed how AI agents could make two significant cryptographic advances in just weeks, uncovering results which can bypass older digital signature protections and factor legacy 1024-bit RSA keys in bulk.

While these results do not affect the security of modern encryption schemes  such as RSA 2048, these results show why we must not assume the mathematical "hardness" of cryptographic schemes which we have relied upon in the past. It also shows how AI can help defenders improve security standards well ahead of future threats.

I have written in more detail about our results, and why they are important for the future of security, in a longer essay which you can read here:

https://t.co/K1TxNdqfQv

celebrity.full_text_en:
New on our Science Blog: How AI is beginning to change scientific modeling.

Scientific models help researchers explain and predict real-world systems—like how a single nerve cell fires, or what happens when neutron stars collide. Recent advances have transformed how scientists fit complex models to data. But scientists still typically write the models manually, and usually need to weigh up several competing versions, each of which might explain the data in a different way.

In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl describe how AI is starting to help with these parts of the process. By writing, running, fitting, and revising scientific models as code, AI can explore many possible model structures, and find out which explanations the data support.

https://t.co/qsFJG76FDw
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我们的科学博客上的新内容：人工智能如何开始改变科学建模。

科学模型帮助研究人员解释和预测现实世界的系统，例如单个神经细胞如何放电，或者中子星碰撞时会发生什么。最近的进展改变了科学家将复杂模型与数据拟合的方式。但科学家通常仍然手动编写模型，并且通常需要权衡几个相互竞争的版本，每个版本都可能以不同的方式解释数据。

在一篇客座文章中，Jakob Macke、Daniel Gedon 和 Stefan Wahl 描述了人工智能如何开始帮助完成该过程的这些部分。通过将科学模型编写、运行、拟合和修改为代码，人工智能可以探索许多可能的模型结构，并找出数据支持哪些解释。

celebrity.full_text_en:
RT @GoogleAI: Meet Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash ⚡️

We’ve made the model more cost-effective, bumped the video generation and editing limit up to 15 seconds, and made updates to how scenes hold together over time. We've also given character speech an upgrade, reduced visual glitches like jump cuts, and made sure the model stays even truer to any reference assets you upload.

So… what does all of that actually mean for you?

It gives you more room to tell your story. With up to 15 seconds to work with, you have more flexibility to create what you need — videos look more cinematic and smooth, offering stronger consistency that keeps objects anchored from start to finish. And when characters speak, the dialogue sounds more fluid and natural.

Creators and everyday users can start directing scenes and multi-turn edits in @FlowbyGoogle, generating 15-second clips at no additional cost in Google Vids, or creating 15-second videos in the @GeminiApp. Plus, for developers and businesses building with the API, we've dropped the price by 30% from the previous generation, making it available at just $0.07 per second for 720p video.

What hit me in @GenLayer's film: bad records ca
celebrity.full_text_en:
She paid to park. A wrong digit and a missing Z sent her to a tribunal.

What hit me in @GenLayer's film: bad records can ruin lives.

GenLayer aims to settle AI-agent disputes in minutes: one AI validator proposes a verdict, others check independently, and decisions can be appealed.

On 27 March 2023, Alison MacPherson paid via RingGo on Hunter Street in Kirkcaldy. She typed 9 for 8 and missed the Z. A penalty followed.

Her receipt matched the time and place. A tribunal sided with her. Fife Council appealed. On 8 January 2024, the Upper Tribunal overturned it and sent it back.

The judge accepted her good faith, but the payment covered another car.

The payment was real. The registration wasn't hers.

Lee Castleton faced worse in the film: Horizon falsely showed a £23,000 gap. Without a lawyer, he faced £321,000 in legal costs and bankruptcy.

AI can't rewrite laws or guarantee truth. Millions of agent deals need evidence checked and decisions open to challenge.

If an AI agent pays under the wrong ID, what matters more: the receipt, the intent or the rule?

#JusticeNeedsAnUpgrade
celebrity.full_text_zh:
她付了停车费。错误的数字和缺失的 Z 将她送上了法庭。

@GenLayer 的电影给我的震撼是：不良记录会毁掉生活。

GenLayer 的目标是在几分钟内解决人工智能代理纠纷：一名人工智能验证者提出裁决，其他人独立检查，并且可以对决定提出上诉。

2023 年 3 月 27 日，Alison MacPherson 在柯科迪亨特街通过 RingGo 付款。她8投9中，但没有击中Z。随后受到了处罚。

她的收据与时间和地点相符。法庭支持她。法伊夫议会提出上诉。 2024 年 1 月 8 日，上级法庭推翻了该判决并将其发回。

法官接受了她的诚意，但付款涵盖了另一辆车。

付款是真实的。登记不是她的。

李·卡斯尔顿 (Lee Castleton) 在影片中面临着更糟糕的情况：地平线错误地显示了 23,000 英镑的差距。在没有律师的情况下，他面临 321,000 英镑的法律费用和破产。

人工智能无法重写法律或保证真相。数以百万计的代理交易需要检查证据，决策也需要接受质疑。

如果人工智能代理使用错误的 ID 付款，收据、意图还是规则哪个更重要？

#JusticeNeedsAnUpgrade

celebrity.full_text_en:
Over the last 20 years across my various businesses I've spent over $15,000 on 'artists'.

Commissioned art work, stuff for streams, fliers, YT stuff, banners, logos, etc...  A few big ticket items, but lots of little projects.

It is hands down the most miserable, time wasting, and laborious processes I've ever experienced when it comes to dealing with contract work.  And I did contracts in heavy civil construction...

A few thousand pissed down the drain on referred artists that just ghosted me after taking deposits.

Thumbnail artists that think they know what is better on a thumbnail than I do, so they completely ignore directions and do their own thing...

Logos that are copy right infringements or such near copies of other work it's shameful.

1 in 5.  MAYBE.  That's how many acted like actual professionals, delivered work on time, did what was asked, and finished the work.  Almost all of those were corporate firms too, not individuals.

It's so bad I've mostly just avoided having to use the industry when ever possible.  But the next time a big project I need comes up I'm going to double book it.

I'll go the traditional route, and the AI route.  And that is what will decide how I spend my money, and more importantly my time, going forward.

The OP is right.  Artists aren't saving their own careers.  They are pushing people to other less shitty interactions, and have been for years.

The difference is, there was no other choice before.  There is now.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在过去 20 年里，我在各种业务中在“艺术家”上花费了超过 15,000 美元。

委托艺术作品、流媒体内容、传单、YT 内容、横幅、徽标等……一些大项目，但还有很多小项目。

这无疑是我在处理合同工作时经历过的最痛苦、最浪费时间、最费力的过程。 我还做过重型土木建筑合同……

几千名被推荐的艺术家在接受存款后就消失了。

缩略图艺术家认为他们比我更知道缩略图上的什么，所以他们完全无视指示并做自己的事情......

侵犯版权或近似复制其他作品的徽标是可耻的。

五分之一。也许吧。 这就是有多少人表现得像真正的专业人士，按时交付工作，完成要求的工作并完成工作。 几乎所有这些都是公司公司，而不是个人。

这太糟糕了，我基本上只是尽可能避免使用这个行业。 但下次当我需要一个大项目时，我会双重预订。

我会走传统路线和人工智能路线。 这将决定我如何花我的钱，更重要的是我的时间。

OP是对的。 艺术家并不是在拯救自己的职业生涯。 他们正在推动人们进行其他不那么糟糕的互动，而且多年来一直如此。

不同的是，之前没有其他选择。 现在有了。

prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；

3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。

prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

Scientific models help researchers explain and predict real-world systems—like how a single nerve cell fires, or what happens when neutron stars collide. Recent advances have transformed how scientists fit complex models to data. But scientists still typically write the models manually, and usually need to weigh up several competing versions, each of which might explain the data in a different way.

In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl describe how AI is starting to help with these parts of the process. By writing, running, fitting, and revising scientific models as code, AI can explore many possible model structures, and find out which explanations the data support.

Scientific models help researchers explain and predict real-world systems—like how a single nerve cell fires, or what happens when neutron stars collide. Recent advances have transformed how scientists fit complex models to data. But scientists still typically write the models manually, and usually need to weigh up several competing versions, each of which might explain the data in a different way.

In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl describe how AI is starting to help with these parts of the process. By writing, running, fitting, and revising scientific models as code, AI can explore many possible model structures, and find out which explanations the data support.

What hit me in @GenLayer's film: bad records ca
viral_posts.title_en:
She paid to park. A wrong digit and a missing Z sent her to a tribunal.

What hit me in @GenLayer's film: bad records can ruin lives.

GenLayer aims to settle AI-agent disputes in minutes: one AI validator proposes a verdict, others check independently, and decisions can be appealed.

On 27 March 2023, Alison MacPherson paid via RingGo on Hunter Street in Kirkcaldy. She typed 9 for 8 and missed the Z. A penalty followed.

Her receipt matched the time and place. A tribunal sided with her. Fife Council appealed. On 8 January 2024, the Upper Tribunal overturned it and sent it back.

The judge accepted her good faith, but the payment covered another car.

The payment was real. The registration wasn't hers.

Lee Castleton faced worse in the film: Horizon falsely showed a £23,000 gap. Without a lawyer, he faced £321,000 in legal costs and bankruptcy.

AI can't rewrite laws or guarantee truth. Millions of agent deals need evidence checked and decisions open to challenge.

If an AI agent pays under the wrong ID, what matters more: the receipt, the intent or the rule?

#JusticeNeedsAnUpgrade

viral_posts.full_text_zh:
她付了停车费。错误的数字和缺失的 Z 将她送上了法庭。

@GenLayer 的电影给我的震撼是：不良记录会毁掉生活。

GenLayer 的目标是在几分钟内解决人工智能代理纠纷：一名人工智能验证者提出裁决，其他人独立检查，并且可以对决定提出上诉。

2023 年 3 月 27 日，Alison MacPherson 在柯科迪亨特街通过 RingGo 付款。她8投9中，但没有击中Z。随后受到了处罚。

她的收据与时间和地点相符。法庭支持她。法伊夫议会提出上诉。 2024 年 1 月 8 日，上级法庭推翻了该判决并将其发回。

法官接受了她的诚意，但付款涵盖了另一辆车。

付款是真实的。登记不是她的。

李·卡斯尔顿 (Lee Castleton) 在影片中面临着更糟糕的情况：地平线错误地显示了 23,000 英镑的差距。在没有律师的情况下，他面临 321,000 英镑的法律费用和破产。

人工智能无法重写法律或保证真相。数以百万计的代理交易需要检查证据，决策也需要接受质疑。

如果人工智能代理使用错误的 ID 付款，收据、意图还是规则哪个更重要？

#JusticeNeedsAnUpgrade

Over the last 20 years across my various businesses I've spent over $15,000 on 'artists'.

Commissioned art work, stuff for streams, fliers, YT stuff, banners, logos, etc...  A few big ticket items, but lots of little projects.

It is hands down the most miserable, time wasting, and laborious processes I've ever experienced when it comes to dealing with contract work.  And I did contracts in heavy civil construction...

A few thousand pissed down the drain on referred artists that just ghosted me after taking deposits.

Thumbnail artists that think they know what is better on a thumbnail than I do, so they completely ignore directions and do their own thing...

Logos that are copy right infringements or such near copies of other work it's shameful.

1 in 5.  MAYBE.  That's how many acted like actual professionals, delivered work on time, did what was asked, and finished the work.  Almost all of those were corporate firms too, not individuals.

It's so bad I've mostly just avoided having to use the industry when ever possible.  But the next time a big project I need comes up I'm going to double book it.

I'll go the traditional route, and the AI route.  And that is what will decide how I spend my money, and more importantly my time, going forward.

The OP is right.  Artists aren't saving their own careers.  They are pushing people to other less shitty interactions, and have been for years.

The difference is, there was no other choice before.  There is now.

viral_posts.full_text_zh:
在过去 20 年里，我在各种业务中在“艺术家”上花费了超过 15,000 美元。

委托艺术作品、流媒体内容、传单、YT 内容、横幅、徽标等……一些大项目，但还有很多小项目。

这无疑是我在处理合同工作时经历过的最痛苦、最浪费时间、最费力的过程。 我还做过重型土木建筑合同……

几千名被推荐的艺术家在接受存款后就消失了。

缩略图艺术家认为他们比我更知道缩略图上的什么，所以他们完全无视指示并做自己的事情......

侵犯版权或近似复制其他作品的徽标是可耻的。

五分之一。也许吧。 这就是有多少人表现得像真正的专业人士，按时交付工作，完成要求的工作并完成工作。 几乎所有这些都是公司公司，而不是个人。

这太糟糕了，我基本上只是尽可能避免使用这个行业。 但下次当我需要一个大项目时，我会双重预订。

我会走传统路线和人工智能路线。 这将决定我如何花我的钱，更重要的是我的时间。

OP是对的。 艺术家并不是在拯救自己的职业生涯。 他们正在推动人们进行其他不那么糟糕的互动，而且多年来一直如此。

不同的是，之前没有其他选择。 现在有了。
